title: Launch HN: Nia (YC S25) – Give better context to coding agents
relevance: Nia aims to solve the hallucination/context problem for coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, which is a prerequisite for safe production deploys. If agents don't have context, they deploy broken code.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
relevance: Direct competitor/peer to Permission Protocol. Provides a control layer including static/behavioral analysis (g0 scan) and runtime monitoring (g0 daemon). Mentions OpenClaw support specifically. High importance.

title: Show HN: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
relevance: Agents specifically designed for infrastructure deployment and management. They SSH into resources and manage production environments directly. High risk/relevance for Permission Protocol gates.

title: Show HN: Vett – Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills before installing
relevance: Addresses supply chain attacks in AI agent skills (SKILL.md). Mentions that OpenClaw agents themselves flagged this. Critical for 'who approved this' and 'what is this agent capable of'.

title: Crafting AI agents platform with $5.5M seed round
relevance: Crafting provides production-like environments for testing and shipping code for AI agents. Validates the market for 'shipping code at scale' via agents.

title: Show HN: Gazill – Save your code, it's live. Built for vibe coders and agents
relevance: Infrastructure tool explicitly optimized for AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code) to deploy 'correctly on first try'.

title: Show HN: VeilStream – Per-Branch Preview Environments
relevance: Includes an MCP server for agents (Claude Code, Cursor) to deploy preview environments directly. Relevant for PR-based deploy gates.
